forms.name: Petrified Saber
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Long
Sword for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Saber
forms.text:
The Petrified Saber's
final form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Ivory Rabbit
forms.text:
A beautiful blade made from
Lagombi that cuts as fierce
as the winter wind.

forms.name: Iced Rabbit
forms.text:
The Ivory Rabbit's final
form, a refined Long Sword
with nary a speck of dirt.

forms.name: Inaba's Thorns
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ivory Rabbit</COL>.

forms.name: Mirage Finsword
forms.text:
A semi-invisible sword made of
Chameleos parts. Good for hit jobs.
Requires Guild permission to own.

forms.name: Phantom Mirage
forms.text:
The Mirage Finsword's final
form. Rumored to have once
been used in assassinations.

forms.name: Skulduggery
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mirage Finsword</COL>.

forms.name: Guardian Sword
forms.text:
An ancient Long Sword made when
the Guild was founded. Gives
the bearer an air of majesty.

forms.name: Imperial Sword
forms.text:
The Guardian Sword's final
form. With it in hand, you'll feel
like you could rule the world.

forms.name: Adamantine Lodestar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardian Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Chainslaughter
forms.text:
A mechanical Long Sword born
of an artisan's bold spirit.
It has a rotating blade.

forms.name: Rumbalarum
forms.text:
The Chainslaughter's final
form. Strong enough to make
lumberjacks cry with joy.

forms.name: Thunder Saw
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chainslaughter</COL>.

forms.name: Aqua Guardian
forms.text:
A Long Sword forged using advanced
sharpening techniques. Based on
texts found in sunken ruins.

forms.name: Atlantica
forms.text:
The Aqua Guardian's final
form marries old wisdom
with new technology.

forms.name: Panthalassa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aqua Guardian</COL>.

forms.name: Gigant Makra
forms.text:
A Long Sword forged from Basarios
parts. Quickly overpowers foes with
its sharpness and weight.

forms.name: Titanic Makra
forms.text:
Gigant Makra's final form. A dense
blade with enormous weight that
quickly makes mincemeat of prey.

forms.name: Makra's Basalt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gigant Makra</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Saber
forms.text:
A Long Sword forged from an
ebon fossil. Its black blade
hides ancient mysteries.

forms.name: Lustrous Kalimia
forms.text:
The Obsidian Saber's final
form. The stiff blade chops
down prey with ease.

forms.name: Ethereal Kalimia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Diapason
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from an Uragaan's
back protrusions. Aerodynamic
prongs ensure graceful swings.

forms.name: Crimsonfork
forms.text:
The Diapason's final
form. The dual blades ensure
the job always gets done.

forms.name: Crimsonfork Zenith
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diapason</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Katana
forms.text:
A Long Sword forged with Eastern
methods. Durable and resilient,
but requires regular upkeep.

forms.name: Iron Gospel
forms.text:
The Iron Katana's final
form. Delivers a message from
the gods with each swing.

forms.name: Iron Banisher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Aikuchi
forms.text:
A Long Sword made imitating
Eastern methods, yielding a
less sharp but sturdy blade.

forms.name: Unbranded Aikuchi
forms.text:
The Aikuchi's final form is
said to have been wielded by
a blind master swordsman.

forms.name: Lieutenant's Aikuchi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aikuchi</COL>.

forms.name: Toad Abetter
forms.text:
A sturdy blade whose hilt and
scabbard resemble wood but
are actually 100% Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Accomplished Abetter
forms.text:
The Toad Abetter's final form.
Why go boulder punching when
you can go boulder splitting?

forms.name: Uncontested Abetter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Toad Abetter</COL>.

forms.name: Plume Sword
forms.text:
An iron blade adorned with
Maccao materials. As regal as
it is devastatingly effective.

forms.name: Plumage Sword
forms.text:
The Plume Sword's final
form. Digs into foes like
the claws of a Maccao.

forms.name: Grand Plumager
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plume Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Khanga Edge
forms.text:
A Long Sword made of Seregios
blades. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Khanga Brink
forms.text:
The Khanga Edge's final
form. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Khanga Rebellion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khanga Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Edge
forms.text:
A Long Sword that never dulls.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Zealous Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Edge's final
form. Not even the guards of
heaven are safe from it.

forms.name: Sedition Gutter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Liquid Fire Blade
forms.text:
Lavasioth Long Sword. Sharp
and strong; breaks through
rock like a torrent of lava.

forms.name: Divine Fire Blade
forms.text:
The Liquid Fire Blade's final
form. Carves valleys like
rivers of molten lava.

forms.name: Molten Volga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Liquid Fire Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Roguemaster
forms.text:
A Long Sword adorned with the
Great Maccao's colorful plumage.
Go on, flaunt your wild side.

forms.name: Gangmaster
forms.text:
Power alone is not enough--the
Roguemaster's final form has
a truly despicable appeal.

forms.name: Bossmaster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Roguemaster</COL>.

forms.name: Eager Cleaver
forms.text:
A beautiful blade forged by
an aimless wanderer from the
East who soon disappeared.

forms.name: Devil Slicer
forms.text:
The Eager Cleaver's final
form. Has a contagious bloodlust
that affects its wielder's soul.

forms.name: True Devil Slicer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eager Cleaver</COL>.

forms.name: Thunderclap
forms.text:
A blade made with Eastern
methods. Blue-white sparks
run down its blade.

forms.name: Heaven's Thunder
forms.text:
The Thunderclap's final
form. Like holding a bolt
of lightning in your hands.

forms.name: Heaven's Thunder Kai
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderclap</COL>.

forms.name: Imperial Saber
forms.text:
A vermilion edge as powerful as
its name suggests. Victims caught
in its light will burn and bleed.

forms.name: Imperial Shimmer
forms.text:
The Imperial Saber's final
form torches anything that
comes within its reach.

forms.name: Imperial Flickerflame
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Imperial Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Wailing Ghost
forms.text:
A sword of hope and regret,
made by a great Blademaster
who was killed by a disciple.

forms.name: Grand Wailing Ghost
forms.text:
The Wailing Ghost's final
form. Those slain by it are
damned to eternal despair.

forms.name: Wrathful Beheader
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wailing Ghost</COL>.

forms.name: Rimeblossom
forms.text:
A Long Sword whose frozen blade
utilizes a new forging process.
Its sheath becomes coated in ice.

forms.name: Rime & Treason
forms.text:
The Rimeblossom's final
form carves prey into
splendid ice sculptures.

forms.name: Frostveldt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rimeblossom</COL>.

forms.name: Yuki Ichimonji
forms.text:
An exotic Long Sword, as light
as a snowflake. Peer into the
blade to see true winter.

forms.name: Silver Ichimonji
forms.text:
The Yuki Ichimonji's final form.
The near-transparent blade
glimmers with each swing.

forms.name: Genjitsu Ichimonji
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yuki Ichimonji</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Saber
forms.text:
An ebon Long Sword, black as
night. An additional blade appears
when gripped with spirit.

forms.name: Deepest Night
forms.text:
The Hidden Saber's final form.
Especially deadly during
moonlit nights.

forms.name: Avidya Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Serrated Jaw
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from a
monster's jaw. Turns
Hunters into butchers.

forms.name: Serrated Maw
forms.text:
The shape of the Serrated
Jaw's final form looks like the
maw of a ferocious dragon.

forms.name: Serrated Chasm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Serrated Jaw</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Katana "Wolf"
forms.text:
Improved Long Sword built on
a bone base. Top edge is
covered in monster fangs.

forms.name: Bone Katana "Dragon"
forms.text:
The final form of the Bone
Katana "Wolf." Getting hit
is like being eaten alive.

forms.name: Bone Katana "Peerless"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Katana "Wolf"</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Verde"
forms.text:
Dark green blade made from
Rathian material. Incredibly
sharp and powerful.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Holly"
forms.text:
The final form of the Wyvern
Blade "Verde." Hold the power
of the queen in your hands.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Jade"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Blade "Verde"</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Blood"
forms.text:
Once this tough blade drinks
the vermilion dusk, the
horrific rites can begin.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Maple"
forms.text:
The final form of Wyvern Blade
"Blood." Leaves trails of burns
behind it with every slash.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Garnet"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Blade "Blood"</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Pale"
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from a pair
of kindred wyverns. Its colorful
edges can slice open the sky.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Bloom"
forms.text:
The final form of the Wyvern
Blade "Pale" consumes prey
with the might of fire.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Mercury"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Blade "Pale"</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Flame"
forms.text:
Made from both Rathian and
Rathalos parts, this blade
channels both land and sky.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Flare"
forms.text:
The final form of the
Wyvern Blade "Flame" consumes
prey with the might of fire.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Perditio"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Blade "Flame"</COL>.

forms.name: Coiled Nail
forms.text:
A uniquely shaped Long Sword.
The blade seems to be as one
with the Najarala.

forms.name: Coiled Pulse Nail
forms.text:
The Coiled Nail's final form.
Stops foes dead in their tracks
with a big emphasis on DEAD.

forms.name: Coiled Rache Nail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Coiled Nail</COL>.

forms.name: Coiled Saber
forms.text:
A redesign of the original to
produce a sharper blade and
a twisted sense of beauty.

forms.name: Paracoiled Saber
forms.text:
The Coiled Saber's final
form. Feels as if it's cursed
with the spirit of the Najarala.

forms.name: Paracoiled Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Coiled Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Boltslicer
forms.text:
The embodiment of a savage king.
If gods exist in this world, this
Long Sword could cut them down.

forms.name: Despot's Boltbreaker
forms.text:
Everything is the same to the
final form of Usurper's
Boltslicer: dead meat.

forms.name: Oppressor's Law
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Boltslicer</COL>.

forms.name: Despot's Boltrunner
forms.text:
A peerless, regal edge that
gleams with pale light. Tremble,
ye gods, when this sword howls.

forms.name: Oppressor's Abyss
forms.text:
The Despot's Boltrunner's final form
is capable of cleaving entire worlds.
The populace bow before its might.

forms.name: Orcus Nitorus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Despot's Boltrunner</COL>.

forms.name: Tigrine Edge
forms.text:
A Long Sword made of Tigrex
parts. Fangs along the blade
beget irreparable wounds.

forms.name: Tigrine Need
forms.text:
The Tigrine Edge's final
form starves constantly for
fresh flesh.

forms.name: Desperate Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tigrine Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Katana
forms.text:
A Long Sword with a Brachydios's
fighting spirit. It can pierce
foes and detonate inside them.

forms.name: Grenade Blade
forms.text:
The Dios Katana's final
form. Life began with a bang
and will end with one, too.

forms.name: D'estruc
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Katana
forms.text:
A sword made of Brachydios parts.
Its scalding blade makes foes
explode, leaving no trace behind.

forms.name: Pyro Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Katana's final
form. Explosive enough to
erase all traces of the past.

forms.name: Pyro Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Edge
forms.text:
A Long Sword whose red-hot blade
sets the environs afire the
moment it leaves its sheath.

forms.name: Lightbreak Cinder
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Edge's final form.
Those cut down by its explosive
quick draw are reduced to ash.

forms.name: Lightbreak Blast
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Black Katana Mk.I
forms.text:
Chemically treated Bone
Katana made using razor-
sharp Hornetaur materials.

forms.name: Black Katana Mk.II
forms.text:
The Black Katana Mk.I's final
evolution. The insect essence
makes it feel soulless.

forms.name: Black Katana Mk.III
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Katana Mk.I</COL>.

forms.name: Blood Cry
forms.text:
A sharp Long Sword as slim
as a Nerscylla leg. Creep in
close and kill prey swiftly.

forms.name: Blood Scream
forms.text:
Blood Cry's final form. The dextrous
blade has been beefed up with an
extra layer of solidity.

forms.name: Shadow Nershriek
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blood Cry</COL>.

forms.name: Noble Blood Cry
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from Nerscylla
parts sharpened to such an extent,
foes don't even notice they're cut.

forms.name: Optimus
forms.text:
The Noble Blood Cry's final form.
The blade always seem to wend its
way towards its victims' hearts.

forms.name: Bioptimus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Noble Blood Cry</COL>.

forms.name: Rusty Claymore
forms.text:
Hybrid created from Rathalos
and Kushala Daora materials.
Its cut is a death sentence.

forms.name: Gaelic Flame
forms.text:
The Rusty Claymore's final
form. Melds the fiery Rathalos
with the speedy Kushala.

forms.name: Last Gaelic Flame
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rusty Claymore</COL>.

forms.name: Canine Katana
forms.text:
A Long Sword made of bones
enmeshed with intimidating
Jaggi fangs.

forms.name: Gnash Katana
forms.text:
The final form of the Canine
Katana. Rips enemies to shreds
with ease.

forms.name: Sunderer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Canine Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Bastine Edge
forms.text:
Formed from Barioth parts, this
amber blade leaves gouts of
bloody ice in its wake.

forms.name: Bastizan Edge
forms.text:
The Bastine Edge's final form. Icy
props to the smith who can work
with materials that generate cold.

forms.name: Amberfang Gelfidall
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bastine Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Dancing Flames
forms.text:
A refined blade of crimson
flame. The heat it emits can
vaporize a foe's blood.

forms.name: Dancing Hellfire
forms.text:
The Dancing Flames's final
form crisps prey down to
their very souls.

forms.name: Principal Flame
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dancing Flames</COL>.

forms.name: Bone
forms.text:
A normal bone sharpened into
a Long Sword. Perfect
as a practice weapon.

forms.name: Large Bone
forms.text:
The Bone Long Sword's final
form excels at Attack. Beloved
by those who love gathering.

forms.name: Oversized Bone
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone</COL>.

forms.name: Anteka Blade
forms.text:
A Long Sword made of Anteka
parts that trades flashiness
for top-tier ease of use.

forms.name: Anteka Rack
forms.text:
The Anteka Blade's final
form. Gives you the ferocious
spirit of a cornered animal.

forms.name: Anteka Cry
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Anteka Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Blango Destroyer
forms.text:
Long Sword made from Blango
materials. It sports cold-
resistant fur in various places.

forms.name: Blango Obliterator
forms.text:
The Blango Destroyer's final
form is your best friend for
hunts in the bitterest cold.

forms.name: Blangocalypse
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blango Destroyer</COL>.

forms.name: Blango Decimator
forms.text:
Long Sword made from Blangonga
materials. Its cold blade
freezes all that approach.

forms.name: Blango Destructor
forms.text:
The Blango Decimator's final
form freezes anything that
gets even remotely close.

forms.name: Blango Gorefest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blango Decimator</COL>.

forms.name: Arzuros Naginata
forms.text:
A Long Sword that blends Arzuros
plate with tempered ore. Used by
barbarians focused on strength.

forms.name: Arzuros Strikequill
forms.text:
The Arzuros Naginata's final
form. The scabbard's markings
come from a famous monk.

forms.name: Arzuros Telltail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arzuros Naginata</COL>.

forms.name: Drowning Shaft
forms.text:
A Long Sword made of Royal
Ludroth sponges. Its watery blows
drown even landlocked foes.

forms.name: Douser Bardiche
forms.text:
Nobody can turn the tide
against the Drowning Shaft's
final incarnation.

forms.name: Wasserfallis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Drowning Shaft</COL>.

forms.name: Daito Crow
forms.text:
True loneliness is known
only by the blade that has
lost even its owner.

forms.name: Daito Wolf
forms.text:
The Daito Crow's final form.
True loneliness is known only by
a blade that has lost its owner.

forms.name: Daito Sin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daito Crow</COL>.

forms.name: Daito Bane
forms.text:
A sword that has outlived
generations of kings and
cut down countless menaces.

forms.name: Garuga Daito
forms.text:
The Daito Bane's final form. The
piles of corpses left in its wake
build a staircase to the heavens.

forms.name: Occult Daito
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daito Bane</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Halberd
forms.text:
Made using the secrets of
Eastern monks. Imbued with
the power of great warriors.

forms.name: Great Demon Halberd
forms.text:
The Demon Halberd's final
form, a Long Sword passed on
from generations of heroes.

forms.name: Evil Demon Halberd
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Halberd</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Katana
forms.text:
A Long Sword imbued with an Eastern
monk's mysterious blessings.
Burns with the Rajang's spirit.

forms.name: Demonlord Asura
forms.text:
The Demonlord Katana's final
form. Seeking it only deepens
one's thirst for carnage.

forms.name: Demonlord Rakshasa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Curviscera
forms.text:
A sword made from a curved
Kecha Wacha talon. Sinks in
and removes chunks of flesh.

forms.name: Incurviscera
forms.text:
The final form of the Curviscera.
Sinks in and removes chunks
of flesh.

forms.name: Incurviscera Telos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Curviscera</COL>.

forms.name: Bicurviscera
forms.text:
A powerful redesign with
two terrible blades that
dance right through prey.

forms.name: Vilcurviscera
forms.text:
The Bicurviscera's final
form. A design with two blades
that dance right through prey.

forms.name: Vilcurviscera Telos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bicurviscera</COL>.

forms.name: Dark Scythe
forms.text:
A sickle-shaped death scythe
that can cut a wyvern in two.
Made from treated material.

forms.name: Tormentor
forms.text:
The Dark Scythe's final form
takes prey's breath away --
literally.

forms.name: Darkness Within
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark Scythe</COL>.

forms.name: Crab Cutter
forms.text:
A splendid scythe made from
Daimyo Hermitaur claw, which
rips through hide and flesh.

forms.name: Daimyo Cutter
forms.text:
The Crab Cutter's final form.
No dragon scale is too tough
for this meaty claw!

forms.name: Gigant Cutter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crab Cutter</COL>.

forms.name: Shogun Cutter
forms.text:
A scythe made from Shogun
Ceanataur parts that makes
for a potent trump card.

forms.name: Killer's Sickle
forms.text:
The Shogun Cutter's final
form is a cleaver sure to
make any battle deadlier.

forms.name: Ceanataur Sickle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shogun Cutter</COL>.

forms.name: Shogun Splitter
forms.text:
A Long Sword that was once
used to separate royalty from
their thrones.

forms.name: Shogun Gouger
forms.text:
The Shogun Splitter's final
form. Carve your name into
history and enemies.

forms.name: Shogun Decimator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shogun Splitter</COL>.

forms.name: Plesioth Splasher
forms.text:
A Long Sword deft as a Plesioth.
It shoots pressurized water,
and the fins keep it classy.

forms.name: Aqua Scythe
forms.text:
The Plesioth Splasher's final
form. Washes away all things
in the blink of an eye.

forms.name: Clearwater Scythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plesioth Splasher</COL>.

forms.name: Scythe of Menace
forms.text:
Laced with poisons created
in absolute secrecy, this is
a weapon for assassination.

forms.name: Big Menacing Scythe
forms.text:
The Scythe of Menace's final
form. Once made taboo for
being so brutal to use.

forms.name: Malicemonger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scythe of Menace</COL>.

forms.name: Mountain Reaper
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from a
Duramboros horn. Lets hunters
reap trees and prey alike.

forms.name: Wild Heights
forms.text:
The Mountain Reaper's final
form cuts through shells
straight into flesh.

forms.name: Wild Summit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mountain Reaper</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Long Sword
forms.text:
A steel Long Sword widely used
in Yukumo. Its hilt is made
from authentic Yukumo wood.

forms.name: Yukumo War Sword
forms.text:
The Yukumo Long Sword's
final form. Everything about it
beams a passion for Yukumo.

forms.name: Hot Spring War Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Long Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Puresword
forms.text:
The Yukumo Long Sword's true
form. Made from the best
materials for best results.

forms.name: Yukumo Spiritblade
forms.text:
The Yukumo Puresword's final
iteration. Flawlessly made, the
crest depicts monster souls.

forms.name: Yukumo Aurablade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Puresword</COL>.

forms.name: Windeater
forms.text:
A weapon born from the memory
of a wyvern that soared long ago.
It's faster than the wind itself.

forms.name: Zephyr
forms.text:
The sleeping dragon flies
once again as the Windeater's
final form.

forms.name: Zephyr Zero
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Windeater</COL>.

forms.name: Notos
forms.text:
A lost fragment? A memory of
the past? Or an enigma sent
to haunt our age?

forms.name: Euros
forms.text:
Notos's final form. A mystical blade
beyond comprehension that harbors
the power of a forgotten era.

forms.name: Boreas
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Notos</COL>.

forms.name: Great Hornfly Saber
forms.text:
Made from insects, this Long
Sword shines like the sun. Opens
a bright future for all bugkind.

forms.name: Master Hornfly Saber
forms.text:
The Great Hornfly Saber's
final form cuts open a bright
future for all bugkind.

forms.name: King Hornfly Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Great Hornfly Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Cheese Knife
forms.text:
You never know. Maybe one
day, you'll actually find a
lactose intolerant monster!

forms.name: Omega Knife
forms.text:
The Cheese Knife's final
evolution: cheese that slices
rather than gets sliced.

forms.name: Mature Omega Knife
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cheese Knife</COL>.

forms.name: Moofah Staff
forms.text:
A basic staff that Moofah
herders employ. Houses a
hidden blade inside.

forms.name: Moofah Blade
forms.text:
The Moofah Staff's final
form. Rarely unsheathed,
beware when it is.

forms.name: Moofah Dreamdasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Moofah Staff</COL>.

forms.name: Kakaru Kumo Naki
forms.text:
The katana of a samurai war
hero. Beautiful and deadly
in equal measure.

forms.name: Tamonowo
forms.text:
The Kakaru Kumo Naki's final
form. Cuts the thread of life
with decisiveness.

forms.name: Tamonowo Zekkarei
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kakaru Kumo Naki</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Beryl"
forms.text:
Each swing of this Long
Sword bathes monsters in
pools of electricity.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Emerald"
forms.text:
The final form of the Wyvern
Blade "Beryl." Covers the skies
in deadly thunderclouds.

forms.name: Wyvern Blade "Alexa"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Blade "Beryl"</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Tower
forms.text:
A Long Sword once used in
maiden dances held to
appease the mountain god.

forms.name: Colossus's Tower
forms.text:
The Giant's Tower's final form.
Wielded by a heretic who
slayed a mountain god.

forms.name: Behemoth's Tower
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Tower</COL>.

forms.name: Billowing Luger
forms.text:
Give your enemies an early
taste of hell with this Long
Sword's flames.

forms.name: Glavenus Hellraiser
forms.text:
The Billowing Luger's final
form splits open the earth
with the Glavenus's rage.

forms.name: Glavenus Hellnova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Billowing Luger</COL>.

forms.name: Stahlfakt
forms.text:
A black, accursed sword that
sends foes hellward before
its wicked eye can blink.

forms.name: Stahlrecht
forms.text:
Eternal anguish beyond hell
awaits victims of the
Stahlfakt's final form.

forms.name: Stahlurteil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stahlfakt</COL>.

forms.name: La Justicière
forms.text:
An iridescent, blessed sword
that parts foes from life in
a stroke of blissful beauty.

forms.name: La Loi
forms.text:
The La Justicière's final
form shines morbidly with
the light of auroras.

forms.name: Le Décalogue
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>La Justicière</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Sword
forms.text:
A bone-laden Long Sword that
liberates all from miseries
inherent to existence.

forms.name: Infernal Sword
forms.text:
The Skeletal Sword's final
form. Engulfs gods in torment
and subsumes their souls.

forms.name: Alrescha Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Pisces
forms.text:
The fins on this Long Sword
swim along the heavenly seas
amidst the stars.

forms.name: Trembling Pisces
forms.text:
The Astral Pisces's final
form washes the wicked in
godly tears.

forms.name: Quivering Pisces
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Pisces</COL>.

forms.name: Hairtail's Hairblade
forms.text:
An eye-catching Long Sword made
with Cutthroat parts. It took
great pains to forge.

forms.name: Fresh Hairblade
forms.text:
Generations of refinement
have led to the final form
of the Hairtail's Hairblade.

forms.name: Premium Hairblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hairtail's Hairblade</COL>.

forms.name: Cawscythe
forms.text:
A haunting Long Sword that
delivers a message of death
across the land.

forms.name: Squawkscythe
forms.text:
The Cawscythe's final
form. Reeks of death from all
the lives it's taken.

forms.name: Screakscythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cawscythe</COL>.

forms.name: Black Scythe
forms.text:
Infused with darkness's
power. Wailing can be heard
from underfoot when swung.

forms.name: Chrono Scythe
forms.text:
The Black Scythe's final
form. Slices from it never
heal, causing constant pain.

forms.name: Fatalis Sickle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Scythe</COL>.

forms.name: Reaver "Cruelty"
forms.text:
A living blade made from
Deviljho meat and bone and
possessing a ruthless bite.

forms.name: Reaver "Calamity"
forms.text:
The final form of the Reaver
"Cruelty" drives the wielder to
kill, kill, and kill some more.

forms.name: Nero's Calamity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Reaver "Cruelty"</COL>.

forms.name: Consummate Katana
forms.text:
A mad sword that addles prey
and wielder alike, seeking
only to slake its bloodlust.

forms.name: Doomblade "Slave"
forms.text:
The Consummate Katana's
final form. Used to mark the
beginning of the blood festival.

forms.name: Transgression
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Consummate Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Centenarian Dagger
forms.text:
A thank you gift from the
Guild with an eternally
shiny luster.

forms.name: Susano Blade
forms.text:
The Centenarian Dagger's
final form. A pure blade that
houses a purifying spirit.

forms.name: Godchaser
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Centenarian Dagger</COL>.

forms.name: Research Saber
forms.text:
Created through a Soaratorium
refining process. Can also be used
to measure defeated specimens.

forms.name: Discovery Saber
forms.text:
The Research Saber's final form.
As a wise man once said, wise is
he who gets wise to the world.

forms.name: Authority Nonius
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Fox Select
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon.
Its noble crest lights the way
towards a bright tomorrow.

forms.name: Press Corps Blade
forms.text:
The Fox Select's final form.
Its golden crest shines on
a future of beauty and joy.

forms.name: Newsflash
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fox Select</COL>.

forms.name: Light Works
forms.text:
A shimmering amber Long Sword
from a foreign land. Its blade
is imbued with lightning.

forms.name: Lightning Works
forms.text:
The Light Works's final form
surges with the power of
ten thousand lightning strikes.

forms.name: Dengeki Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Light Works</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Sword J
forms.text:
The Long Sword of a legendary
pirate. The golden skull on the
hilt glitters near treasure.

forms.name: Buccaneer Sword J
forms.text:
The Pirate Sword J's final
form, its blade glitters with
the gleam of rare booty.

forms.name: Pirate King Sword J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Sword J</COL>.

forms.name: Wing of Judgment
forms.text:
The embodiment of an almighty
deity's wing. One swing can
quell any calamity.

forms.name: Wing of Judgment X
forms.text:
Wing of Judgment's final form.
Delivers a cruel fate upon any
foolish enough to defy it.

forms.name: Wing of Judgment XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wing of Judgment</COL>.

forms.name: Fan Club Bamboo Rod
forms.text:
A weapon for true Monster
Hunter fans! Imbued with charity,
discipline, and the hunting spirit.

forms.name: Fan Club Deluxe Rod
forms.text:
The Fan Club Bamboo Rod's
final form. The perfect
weapon for passionate fans.

forms.name: Fan Club Super Rod
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fan Club Bamboo Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Katana
forms.text:
Long Sword with the power of the
black god. Those who wield it
become detached from the world.

forms.name: Akantor Strongsword
forms.text:
The Akantor Katana's final
form can bend the world
to its whim.

forms.name: Akantor Tyranny
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Katana</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Slicer
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's fourth power: its roar.
A slash can part the seas.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skydicer
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Slicer's final
form. Splits heaven and earth
like the beginning of days.

forms.name: Ukanlos Worldcleaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Slicer</COL>.

forms.name: Ominous Spring
forms.text:
A godly blade whose justice
no creature in this world
can hope to escape.

forms.name: Heavenly Clearing
forms.text:
The Ominous Spring's final
form. Metes out divine judgment
so that all might be saved.

forms.name: Empyrean Eve
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ominous Spring</COL>.

forms.name: Dark Claw
forms.text:
A large, black scythe that
resembles the talons of
an Alatreon.

forms.name: Dark Claw "Demise"
forms.text:
The Dark Claw's final form
corrupts and transfigures the
wielder's soul bit by bit.

forms.name: Altheos Altrusta
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark Claw</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Long Sword
forms.text:
The hail of strikes from the Argent
Comet's blade rain down like
shooting stars, fierce and lonely.

forms.name: Dragonstar Hakta
Magnastar Yuj
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Long Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Saber
forms.text:
A Long Sword from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
Severs prey effortlessly in twain.

forms.name: Sage Saber
forms.text:
The Elder Saber's final form.
Its crimson blade cuts through all
known matter.

forms.name: Philosopher Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Saber</COL>.

forms.name: Rushin' Blue
forms.text:
The blue trim applied to the sheath
has a paralytic effect. How darkly
those red eyes shine!

forms.name: Catatonia
forms.text:
The Rushin' Blue's final form meshes
two conflicting colors to transfix the
mind in a discordant harmony.

forms.name: Purre Catatonia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rushin' Blue</COL>.

forms.name: Urano Metria
forms.text:
Stars across the universe,
show yourselves to me
with all your brilliance!

forms.name: Urano Metria Charta
forms.text:
Urano Metria's final form.
I am the ruler of the stars.
Open thy savage gate!

forms.name: Urano Metria Caelum
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Urano Metria</COL>.

forms.name: Übel/Equité
forms.text:
A Long Sword whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Verzeihung/Jugement
forms.text:
The Übel/Equité's final form. Shows
its true potential only to those who
would command chaos.

forms.name: Chaos/Loi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Übel/Equité</COL>.

forms.name: Burning Dragonsword
forms.text:
One of the prized dragonslayer
swords. Part Lao-Shan Lung,
part ore.

forms.name: Bloodred Dragonsword
forms.text:
The Burning Dragonsword's final
form. Its ceaseless fire serves as a
reminder of its power and beauty.

forms.name: Inferno Dragonsword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Burning Dragonsword</COL>.

forms.name: Goldscythe
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a serpent
who guides wandering souls.

forms.name: Inscribed Ta Dehent
forms.text:
The Goldscythe's final form is
the incarnation of a soul-guiding
goddess, reborn into the world.

forms.name: Meretseger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldscythe</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Scythe
forms.text:
The great scythe of red fury.
Be as Death and soak the
world in despair.

forms.name: Fatalis Reaper
forms.text:
The Fatalis Scythe's final form.
Let those beyond salvation shed
tears as they realize their fate.

forms.name: Fatalis Rapture
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Scythe</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Ascencia
forms.text:
The great scythe with an old
Fatalis's argent gleam. Even the
blood it draws fears touching it.

forms.name: Fatalis Purificatio
forms.text:
The Fatalis Ascencia's final form.
The blessed fangs are come to
cleanse the world's defilement.

forms.name: Fatalis Veneranda
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Ascencia</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Maw
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Redhelm parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Redhelm Cutter
forms.text:
The Crimson Maw's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Brush With Death
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Maw</COL>.

forms.name: Ebon Rabbit
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Snowbaron parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystal Rabbit
forms.text:
The Ebon Rabbit's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Jackalope's Thorns
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ebon Rabbit</COL>!

forms.name: Stonefist Cutter
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Black Stonefist Cutter
forms.text:
The Stonefist Cutter's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigacutter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stonefist Cutter</COL>!

forms.name: Demon Swirl
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Treacherous Swirl
forms.text:
The Demon Swirl's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Mutinous Swirl
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Swirl</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Saber
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Saber
forms.text:
The Nightfall Saber's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Dawngust Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Saber</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Saber
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Saber
forms.text:
The Geode Saber's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Saber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Saber</COL>!

forms.name: Daito Calamity
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Shogun Daito
forms.text:
The Daito Calamity's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Destruction
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daito Calamity</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Saber
forms.text:
A Long Sword made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Saber
forms.text:
The Tomb Saber's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Dreadking's Heir
forms.text:
